reviewer: Claude (Opus 5), 2026-10-02. Each value was translated back to English without the English original in view, then compared for meaning: a dropped clause, an inverted negation, a lost "instead". Two fixes came out of it — es accountRecipients.privacy.ownAccounts gained "En cambio" for English's "instead", and ja receive.privacy.publicAddress gained "いずれかの" for "one of your Seedelfs". NO NATIVE SPEAKER HAS READ THESE. That is the accepted risk (post-release roadmap, open question 2); a user who reports an error is the feedback loop working. Round two (Lovejoin's page, 2026-10-03) back-translated 34 more, the "not mixed yet" warning and the seed's among them. One change came out of it: ja lovejoin.warn.notMixed.why.both was recast as a 「…については」 pair, because the two counts it carries read as one number in the straight order. Round three (Minswap's swap screens, 2026-10-03) back-translated 16 more, the quote's and the Lovejoin switch's privacy notes among them. One change came out of it: ja swaps.warn.impact says 「{{token}} 1 単位あたりの受取額」 ("the amount received per unit of {{token}}") where English says "each {{token}} gets", which reads as a quantity rather than as the token acting. Round four (the connector's window and a site's session, 2026-10-03) back-translated 17 more, what each connection lets a site learn among them. No correction came out of the Japanese pass this round. Round five (the review fixes, 2026-10-03) back-translated 13 more: a dApp's staking certificates as whole sentences (dappUi.cert.warn.*), pool.warn.retiringSoon and claim.warn.skippedItem; the certificates join their clauses in the connective form (登録し、…ステーキングし、…委任します) and name the vote's delegate in parentheses (委任先: …) rather than after an ASCII colon, and the reviewer is still Claude and no native speaker has read them. Round six (the whole-locale review's corrections, 2026-10-03): 35 critical values were corrected and back-translated again, among them dappUi.privacy.publicAccount (the warning that a site can still recognise this browser after it is moved to a private session, which 同じです had lost), dappUi.warn.unknownInputs (the stake key, the only signer, spends none of the UTxOs the wallet couldn't find), mint.privacy.fromPrivate (money other people paid your Seedelf, not payments to theirs), utxos.warn.someUnspendable (anyone can send you one), claim.privacy.throughLovejoin (the first few sessions, not only the first), settings.privacy.eachSeesIp (every transaction reaches Koios from the IP address that reads the public account) and swaps.pick.warn.notListed (the wallet swaps into no token Minswap hasn't verified), with 「最大」 for the Max button, ブラウザ, レジスター, ADA Handle and 取れて (take) throughout, while the 13 keys round five added were back-translated blind by a second reader with no change; the reviewer is still Claude and no native speaker has read them. A second reader then checked every value the round changed and back-translated the 48 critical ones blind again: every one matched, and no critical value changed.
